concerns.text: FR-004 requires calculation of **observed statistical power** using `statsmodels.stats.power`, but no task in `tasks.md` implements this calculation; the existing T007 computes Minimum Detectable Effect Size (MDES) instead.
FR-006 calls for an **A‑Priori Power Analysis** capability for future study design, yet no task addresses this functionality.
FR-007 mandates validation that a publication reports the specific **univariate effect size** before extraction, but the task list lacks a dedicated verification step.
SC-002 measures the **fraction of studies with observed power < 0.8**; because observed power is never computed, this success criterion cannot be evaluated.
SC-003 requires measuring **total execution time** against CI job limits, yet the only performance task (T010) records metrics without a verification test asserting compliance with the limits.
SC-004 requires measuring **memory usage** against the RAM limit; similarly, T010 records peak RSS but no test checks it against the defined threshold.
Constitution principle I (Reproducibility) demands that **random seeds be pinned** in all code, but no task ensures this or verifies seed pinning.
Constitution principle II (Verified Accuracy) requires a **citation verification gate** (Reference‑Validator Agent); the task list contains no task that implements or tests this gate.
